must_identify.item: The container being killed is the log-shipper sidecar, not the api container
must_identify.evidence: both 1/2 Ready, log-shipper OOMKilled repeatedly; the api container itself is healthy/Ready in both.

must_identify.item: The sidecar is OOMKilled because its 16Mi limit is below its usage
must_identify.evidence: Allocating 40MB instantly exceeds the 16Mi limit, so the kernel OOM-kills it (OOMKilled, exit code 137) within seconds of starting, every time

notes: The RCA quotes the sidecar's Python code. The commands may have surfaced it through the describe output, but a reviewer should confirm that the quoted snippet matches the actual container spec. The RCA also says the old ReplicaSet pod is still running at 1/1.
